description: Compute daily mark prices from Silver trades
steps: Create src/prediction_data/gold/market_marks.py
Read Silver polymarket.trades for a given date, grouped by (market_id, outcome_id)
Compute mark_price as VWAP (volume-weighted average price) for the day, falling back to last trade price if < N trades
Compute volume_usd_24h as sum of usd_amount for the day
Compute trades_count_24h as count of trades
Compute last_trade_price from the latest trade by timestamp
Compute active_wallets_24h as count of distinct maker + taker addresses

description: Derive liquidity proxy metric for markets
steps: Research feasibility of computing open_interest_usd from position state data
If open_interest not feasible, implement proxy: trailing 7-day average daily volume
Add liquidity_metric field to market_mark_daily output
Document the chosen liquidity proxy methodology in code comments

description: Write market_mark_daily to S3 Gold Parquet
steps: Define PyArrow schema for market_mark_daily Parquet files
Write daily partitions to s3://.../gold/market_mark_daily/day=YYYY-MM-DD/part-*.parquet
Support backfill: process date ranges sequentially
Add idempotent partition overwrite
Write ClickHouse DDL for market_mark_daily (MergeTree, PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(day_utc), ORDER BY (platform, market_id, outcome_id, day_utc), TTL day_utc + INTERVAL 90 DAY)
Implement CH loader: read S3 Gold Parquet → insert into ClickHouse
Support configurable lookback window (--lookback-days N, default 90)

description: CLI commands and testing for market marks
steps: Implement `prediction-data gold compute-marks --dt YYYY-MM-DD [--dry-run]`
Implement `prediction-data gold compute-marks --start-date YYYY-MM-DD --end-date YYYY-MM-DD`
Write unit tests for VWAP and metric computation with known trade data
Write integration test: Silver trades → market_mark_daily S3 + CH round-trip
